info.name: Hochat Online API
info.description:
REST API for Hochat Online (Laravel 13 + Sanctum).

1. Start Laragon (MySQL) and `composer run dev`.
2. Run the three **Login** requests first. They save the tokens into collection variables automatically.
3. Every request sends `Accept: application/json`.

Sample accounts (password `password`): admin@hochat.test, staff@hochat.test, user@hochat.test.

Status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 204 No Content, 401 not logged in, 403 not allowed, 404 not found, 422 validation error.
